title: Define audit log schema and AuditEvent enum
description:
Define AuditEvent enum: ArticleSigned { message_id, cid, key_fingerprint }, AuthAttempt { peer_addr, user, success }, PeerBlacklisted { peer_id, reason, duration_secs }, GcRun { articles_unpinned, group_name }, AdminAccess { peer_addr, path, method, status_code }. Define audit_log table in SQLite: (id, timestamp, event_type, event_json). All events serialized as JSON. Artifact: core/src/audit.rs.

Acceptance: all event types defined; audit_log table is append-only (no UPDATE/DELETE in migration); event_json is valid JSON for all variants; unit test: serialize each event type and verify JSON round-trip
